name: Vulcan Centaur
tagline: Atlas V + Delta IV successor; certifies for NSSL Phase 3 + planned for Dream Chaser
description: United Launch Alliance's two-stage successor to Atlas V and Delta IV. Powered by twin BE-4 methalox engines on the first stage and Centaur V (RL10) above. First flight 2024-01-08 carried Astrobotic Peregrine. Slated to certify for National Security Space Launch Phase 3 contracts and planned as the launch vehicle for Sierra Space's Dream Chaser cargo spaceplane.
